data.reasoningText:
I notice the form isn't resetting origin/destination when locationId changes, since the existing effect only triggers off isEditMode, existingData, or supplyOrderData. The simplest fix is adding locationId to that reset effect for the create-without-supply-order scenario.

I'll write a new effect that only applies in the plain create case—when neither isEditMode nor supplyOrderId is set—setting origin to locationId if internal, or destination if external, matching the same logic used in the defaults. This should sit right after the existing effect, and I'll skip applying it when there's a supplyOrderId since that data source is authoritative for origin/destination in that flow.
